decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system builds on the firm's existing robust outdoor/transport lighting and marine searchlight knowledge, so it can interpret early results and improve the product.
General interior lighting is close to the firm's core building-lighting expertise, enabling it to assimilate market feedback and refine the luminaire.
The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics is central to the firm's optical and lighting knowledge and its stated strategic direction, making learning and improvement likely.
The marine searchlight is related to the firm's outdoor, transport and demanding-environment lighting competencies, so the firm has the absorptive capacity to keep it.
